$comment: ISSUES MODULE (pack: issues) — targets bizapps-issues (B202606091000, schema __mj_BizAppsIssues, prefix 'MJ_BizApps_Issues: '). Slice: IssueType/IssueStatus/Issue/IssueNumberSequence. Issues DERIVE from real facts: overdue orders → billing tickets, dissolved employers → data-correction requests, paid no-shows → refund requests, plus the authored Kate/Kathy duplicate report. Status mix rides recency (old issues resolved, recent ones open).

billing.$note: ESTIMATE — share of members with an overdue order who file a ticket

refunds.$note: ESTIMATE — share of paid no-shows who ask about refunds

general.$note: ESTIMATE — thin stream of fact-free portal inquiries (logins, newsletter, directory) every real support queue carries; gives the General type real volume instead of the single authored row it had

dataCorrection.$note: one per member whose employer had a lifecycle event while they were active (incl. Danielle)

severity.$note: severity = IMPACT, drawn per type; priority = URGENCY, derived from the type default with a severity bump (priorityRule) — decoupled so boards show a real matrix instead of a wall of Medium. ESTIMATE distributions.
severity.$floorNote: Critical is rare by design and only Billing and Events carry weight for it. Billing is ~5 tickets at demo scale, so the DRAW yields zero about half the time — and a share gate with a tolerance band passes happily on zero. If the draws come up dry, the highest-impact eligible ticket is promoted deterministically (see issues.mjs). A support queue with no critical ticket in 13 years is not a support queue.

priorityRule.$note: start from the type's default priority; bump one rung when severity >= bumpIfSeverityAtLeast; independently drop one rung for a small noise share (real triage is imperfect)

assignment.$note: assigned issues go to committee OFFICERS (active-term Chairs/Vice-Chairs) — the renewal-outreach-to-chair precedent; New issues are more often still unassigned

comments.$note: Every ticket used to have an empty activity feed. Comments derive from the ticket's own state: a triage note when it was picked up, member replies, and a resolution note on terminal tickets. Source is CHECK-constrained to inbound/outbound/internal. NOTE the table has NO author-settable timestamp — only the system __mj_CreatedAt, which the entity SPs re-stamp on a metadata push — so each body opens with its own date, the same workaround the issue Description already uses.
